description: React component for Marketplace UI, managing templates and custom templates with filtering, view toggling, and navigation.

methods.name: share
methods.description: Prepares and opens the share dialog for a template.

methods.name: getSelectStyles
methods.description: Returns styling for select components based on border color and theme mode.

methods.name: handleTabChange
methods.description: Handles tab switching between community and user templates.

methods.name: clearAllUsecases
methods.description: Clears selected usecases based on active tab.

methods.name: handleBadgeFilterChange
methods.description: Updates badge filter and recalculates eligible usecases.

methods.name: handleTypeFilterChange
methods.description: Updates type filter and recalculates eligible usecases.

methods.name: handleFrameworkFilterChange
methods.description: Updates framework filter and recalculates eligible usecases.

methods.name: handleViewChange
methods.description: Switches between card and list view, storing preference.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates search term and recalculates eligible usecases.

methods.name: onDeleteCustomTemplate
methods.description: Confirms and deletes a custom template, with snackbar notifications.

methods.name: filterFlows
methods.description: Filters data based on search term.

methods.name: filterByBadge
methods.description: Filters data by selected badge tags.

methods.name: getEligibleUsecases
methods.description: Calculates and sets eligible usecases based on filters.

methods.name: onUseTemplate
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new tool based on selected template.

methods.name: goToTool
methods.description: Opens dialog to view selected tool template.

methods.name: goToCanvas
methods.description: Navigates to specific marketplace canvas based on chatflow type.
